decisions.reason: Although it builds directly on the firm's trusted second-channel security know-how, its absence from the website for two years suggests it is better absorbed into broader platform offerings than kept as a distinct product.

The firm has strong related knowledge in mobile signing and authorization, but the lack of later visibility indicates the standalone mobile PDF signing function was likely overtaken by broader identity and contract-signing solutions.

This security architecture remains the closest to the firm's core cryptography and platform expertise, so absorptive capacity is highest here and the product is still worth retaining as a strategic core capability.

While related to the firm's secure communication stack, this narrower delivery use case appears to have had weaker standalone traction and is the most sensible candidate to discontinue and fold into broader services.
